title: The 8 Best Safety Glasses for Woodworking 2026
h1: The 8 Best Safety Glasses for Woodworking 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for safety glasses for woodworking 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at safety glasses for woodworking 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: DEWALT DPG82-11 Concealer Clear Anti-Fog Dual Mold Safety Goggle
products.blurb: Key specs: ANSI Z87.1+, Anti-fog lens, Wraparound.
strengths: ANSI Z87.1+ rated -- the correct minimum standard for woodworking eye protection
Wraparound lens provides side protection that standard glasses do not
Anti-fog coating stays clear during high-exertion sawing and sanding
The most commonly used safety glasses in woodworking shops and on job sites
limitations: Fit is narrow -- may be tight on wider faces
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: 3M Safety Glasses, SecureFit 400 Series, Anti-Fog, Anti-Scratch Lens
products.blurb: Key specs: Pressure diffusion temples, Flexible temples, ANSI Z87.1+.
strengths: Pressure-diffusion temple technology distributes temple pressure -- the most comfortable safety glasses for extended wear
The correct safety glasses for all-day shop sessions where comfort determines compliance
Flexible temples fit a wide range of head sizes without adjustment
3M anti-fog coating that outlasts most competitors
limitations: Less available at hardware stores -- primarily online

products.name: Honeywell Uvex Stealth Safety Goggles with Clear Uvextreme Anti-Fog Lens
products.blurb: Key specs: Full seal, Indirect ventilation, ANSI Z87.1+.
strengths: Full sealed goggle -- provides complete debris protection including from above and below
Indirect ventilation prevents fogging while blocking chips and sawdust
The correct eye protection for grinding, routing, and operations with significant debris
Fits over prescription glasses -- the correct solution for woodworkers who wear glasses
limitations: Less comfortable than safety glasses for all-day wear
Indirectly vented goggles fog faster than safety glasses in hot shops

products.name: Pyramex Safety Emerge Plus Readers Safety Glasses, 1.5 Diopters
products.blurb: Key specs: Bifocal lens, Magnification options, ANSI Z87.1+.
strengths: Bifocal safety glasses combine eye protection and reading magnification in one
Available in multiple diopter strengths for different vision needs
The correct solution for woodworkers who need reading glasses for layout, measuring, and fine detail work
ANSI Z87.1+ rated at the same standard as non-bifocal safety glasses
limitations: Bifocal segment is small -- may not suit all reading tasks
Must order the correct diopter strength

products.name: Gateway Safety Cover2 Safety Glasses Protective Eye Wear - Over-The-Glass (OTG)
products.blurb: Key specs: Bulk pack, ANSI Z87.1+, 10-pack or more.
strengths: Bulk pack pricing -- the correct approach for teaching workshops and shared shop spaces
ANSI Z87.1+ rated at a very low per-unit cost
Keeping glasses everywhere (at each machine, at the workbench) increases compliance
Wraparound lens for side protection
limitations: Lower comfort than premium options for extended wear
Anti-fog performance is less than 3M or DeWalt
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Milwaukee Tinted Performance Safety Glasses
products.blurb: Key specs: Gray tinted lens, ANSI Z87.1+, Anti-fog.
strengths: Gray tinted lens for outdoor woodworking -- reduces glare on bright days
ANSI Z87.1+ rated at the same standard as clear alternatives
Anti-fog coating for temperature transitions (shop to outdoors)
The correct lens choice for deck building, exterior trim, and outdoor woodworking
limitations: Tinted lens is too dark for indoor use in most shops
A second pair of clear glasses is still needed for indoor work

products.name: Honeywell Retail Vapor Scratch-Resistant Safety Glasses, Clear Lens
products.blurb: Key specs: Anti-scratch lens, ANSI Z87.1+, Polycarbonate lens.
strengths: Anti-scratch coating for high-abrasion shop environments where lenses get set down on rough surfaces
Adjustable temples for custom fit on different head sizes
Polycarbonate lens -- the correct material for impact resistance in a woodworking shop
Honeywell industrial safety quality
limitations: Less available than DeWalt or 3M at hardware stores

products.name: Chums Original Cotton Eyewear Retainer - Adjustable Unisex Sunglasses Keeper
products.blurb: Key specs: Neck strap, Safety glasses retainer, Adjustable.
strengths: Retainer strap keeps safety glasses around the neck when not in use -- eliminates setting them down
Glasses around the neck are faster to put on than glasses left at a workstation
The most effective single change for improving safety glasses compliance in a shop
Universal fit works with any safety glasses with standard temples
limitations: Strap can catch on machinery -- remove in tight spaces near rotating equipment
Some woodworkers find neck straps irritating

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
